content:
incident-bot: [ALERT] 1965004321 - service: log-shipper - backlog > 2000 events (10m) - page oncall
oncall-maya: acknowledged. pulling grafana and log indices now. @sre-alex can you join?
sre-alex: joining. initial look: shipper's output queue spiked, retries to remote-syslog returning 429s at 01:03:12 UTC
eng-runtime-tess: also seeing increased tail latency on request paths that do synchronous audit writes. possible backpressure
ops-omar: infra check: nodes healthy, but network egress to external log endpoint showing packet drops in that window
support-harper: two enterprise customers reported missing audit entries; they flagged for compliance evidence. raising high-priority support tickets
sec-raj: flagging this for SOC and compliance: missing audit entries are a risk. opening SOC-8110. need to preserve evidence and determine exposure
incident-bot: action recorded: oncall-maya acknowledged at 1965004325
oncall-maya: mitigation steps: 1) flip shipper to degraded local-buffer mode (local-buffer=true) 2) disable synchronous audit writes on public API paths. doing now
eng-runtime-tess: toggled disable-sync-audit=true at 01:06:00 UTC
ops-omar: enabled local buffer at 01:06:05. buffer size set to 50000 events, flush interval 30s
sre-alex: monitoring. backlog stopped growing and started draining slowly
support-harper: customer reports indicate most missing entries are from 01:02-01:06 UTC window. collating affected request ids
sec-raj: don't forget chain-of-custody. ops, take a snapshot of host logs and config and upload to secure evidence store. include checksums
ops-omar: archiving now: /var/incident_evidence/1965004321/
ops-omar: uploading to gs://redwood-incident-evidence/1965004321/; checksum sha256:f4d1...a7b
legal-ivy: loop me in for any requests about preserved evidence. if customers ask for proof of retention, we'll need the chain and the memo
sre-alex: grepping logs for auth failures and policy denies; nothing abnormal besides shipper 429s and retry backoff traces. sample:
```
2026-10-12T01:03:12Z shipper[pid=1987] WARN remote: 429 Too Many Requests - retrying in 5s
2026-10-12T01:03:13Z api[pid=1145] WARN audit: sync-write delayed=120ms
```
oncall-maya: impact estimate: ~2.1% of total requests had audit write delays; ~0.3% likely missing events (pending verification)
product-lina: schedule postmortem review. propose 2026-10-12 16:00 PT (30m) to cover technical root cause and customer comms
oncall-maya: ok for me
sre-alex: ok
sec-raj: will attend; want to discuss remediation to prevent audit loss and compliance notification thresholds
legal-ivy: will join for customer evidence/notifications guidance
support-harper: assembling customer impact list and draft status message
incident-bot: postmortem doc created: INC-1965004321 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-1965004321)
oncall-maya: capturing action items here (owners + due dates):
- A1) Implement rate-limited exponential backoff + jitter in shipper with smart requeue to avoid large synchronous retries. owner: @sre-alex. due: 2026-10-20
- A2) Add local disk-backed durable buffer with encrypted rotation and guaranteed-once semantics for audit events. owner: @ops-omar. due: 2026-11-01
- A3) Change default path: make audit writes best-effort async for public API thresholds > 1rps per token. owner: @eng-runtime-tess. due: 2026-10-29
- A4) Compliance: perform a gap analysis of retained audit data for 01:00-01:10 UTC and produce a memo for regs. owner: @sec-raj. due: 2026-10-15
- A5) Evidence: verify uploaded archive checksum and record chain-of-custody in postmortem doc. owner: @ops-omar. due: 2026-10-13
- A6) Customer comms: targeted emails + status update on status.redwood.ai. owner: @support-harper. due: 2026-10-13
- A7) Legal: draft standard disclosure language and review compliance obligations for affected tenants. owner: @legal-ivy. due: 2026-10-14
- A8) Observability: add synthetic audit-event end-to-end check every 2min and alert if ingestion fails. owner: @sre-alex. due: 2026-10-18
oncall-maya: owners assigned in Jira INC-1965004321; adding dependencies and risk notes
eng-runtime-tess: quick follow-up: propose adding a feature-flag to opt-in to sync audit for high-security tenants only (default off). will draft RFC
sec-raj: also proposing a policy change: require automated escalation to SOC if loss of audit events > 0.5% for >5min for any production tenant
product-lina: good point. we'll include policy/contract implications in postmortem
ops-omar: uploaded evidence and metadata. gs://redwood-incident-evidence/1965004321/manifest.json
ops-omar: manifest checksum sha256:f4d1...a7b
incident-bot: SOC ticket SOC-8110 created and linked to the incident
support-harper: draft status blurb for review:
"At 01:02 UTC we observed transient failures in our external log ingestion endpoint which caused a short window of elevated audit write delays. We mitigated by switching the shipper to local-buffer mode and making writes asynchronous. A post-incident review is scheduled. Affected customers will be contacted directly if their audit evidence is incomplete."
product-lina: LGTM, will coordinate release after SOC memo
oncall-maya: handoff note: oncall evening primary is @sre-jordan. leaving this thread for postmortem updates and compliance follow-ups. thanks team :heart:
incident-bot: thread marked resolved at 1965005400
